sloka: अहं सखा ते काकुत्स्थ प्रियः प्राणो बहिश्चरः ।गरुत्मानिह सम्प्राप्तो युवाभ्यां साह्यकारणात् ।। ६.५०.४६ ।।।।
transliteration: ahaṁ sakhā te kākutstha priyaḥ prāṇo bahiścaraḥ ।garutmāniha samprāpto yuvābhyāṁ sāhyakāraṇāt ।। 6.50.46 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Kakuthsa! I am Garuthman, your dear friend and your outer breath. I reached here to help you."
